mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS seat_id, s.section AS section, s.row_no AS row_no, s.seat_no AS seat_no, s.aisle_after AS aisle_after, s.grade AS grade, s.status AS status, s.price AS price FROM seat s WHERE s.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY s.section ASC, s.row_no ASC, s.seat_no ASC
SELECT DISTINCT s.grade AS grade, s.price AS price FROM seat s WHERE s.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY s.price DESC
